entities.name: Old Voda Sea
entities.description: Current name of the sea surrounding Sarpadia on Dominaria, once home to the Vodalian empire.

entities.name: Vodalian Merfolk
entities.description: Merfolk empire ruled by a militant, magic-wielding upper class.

entities.name: Empress Galina III
entities.description: Vodalian ruler who led her subjects through a portal to Etlan Shiis.

entities.name: Karel Volnikov
entities.description: Marshall who led the Vodalian army against the homarids.

entities.name: Homarids
entities.description: Invaders who overwhelmed the merfolk through their ability to breed.

entities.name: Svyelun
entities.description: Goddess of the Pearl Moon with temples across the ocean floor.

entities.name: Dromar
entities.description: Blue primeval dragon once housed in Dromar's Cavern.

entities.name: Dromar's Cavern
entities.description: Ancient Vodalian tomb in the Old Voda part of the trench.

entities.name: Sarpadia
entities.description: Isolated continent surrounded by the sea.

entities.name: Etlan Shiis
entities.description: Far-away place where the merfolk renamed a sea Voda Sea.

entities.name: Svyelunite Temple
entities.description: Ruins found in the Old Voda Sea.

entities.name: Fall of the Sarpadian Empires
entities.description: Event during which merfolk abandoned the Vodalian empire.

events.summary: Homarids invade Vodalian territory and Marshall Karel Volnikov leads the army against them.
events.quote: Marshall Karel Volnikov led the Vodalian army against them.

events.summary: Vodalia is abandoned and many follow Empress Galina III through a portal to Etlan Shiis.
events.quote: many of its subjects followed Empress Galina III through a portal to far away Etlan Shiis

relations.note: The homarids invaded and overwhelmed the merfolk.
relations.quote: When the homarids invaded their territory

relations.note: She ruled after the emperor died.
relations.quote: leaving Empress Galina III as the ruler

relations.note: The tomb lies deep in the Old Voda part of the trench.
relations.quote: Deep in the Old Voda part of the deep-sea trench lies Dromar's Cavern
